English: Woodcarvers Bench
A simple bench for shaping wood, supporting nomad crafts and camp repairs.
Potters Shed
A makeshift shelter for clay work, producing essential wares for the clans daily needs.
Tanners Tent
A canvas tent where hides are cured, improving supplies and increasing clan resilience.
Metalworkers Hut
A sturdy hut for forging tools and weapons, bolstering military readiness for the horde.
Weavers Pavilion
A spacious tent where skilled hands craft textiles, enhancing comfort and population growth.
Fine Smithy
A well-equipped smithy producing superior tools and arms, empowering both artisans and warriors.
Guild Workshop
A large communal workspace for skilled artisans, fostering innovation and economic growth.
Master Craftsmans Hall
A grand hall where the most talented artisans gather, setting standards for craftsmanship and unity.
Guildhall
A fortified center for artisan guilds, organizing production and boosting the hordes prosperity.
Great Artisan Guild
The pinnacle of nomadic craftsmanship, this legendary guild draws artisans from afar, greatly empowering the clans might, unity, and prosperity.
